<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 193.1103, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of about 192.103 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass with common organic elements is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (monoisotopic mass ≈ 192.115 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No additional hetero‑atoms are required, so the formula fits the required “CxHyOzX” pattern with X omitted.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
